metaDesc: Landzela sikhatsi seTestamente Lendzala, imphilo yaJesu, netinkhambo taPawula emephini yangempela — iBhayibheli yenteka etindzaweni tangempela.

s.title: IBhayibheli ngeMephu
s.verse: “Empeleni sasingalandzeli tinganekwane tebucili, ngesikhatsi sinatisa emandla nekufika kweNkhosi yetfu Jesu Khristu, kodvwa sasingulabo labawabona emandla ebukhosi bakhe.” (2 yaPhetro 1:16)
s.purpose: IBhayibheli akusiyo inganekwane. Kubhalwa kwebantfu labahamba etindzaweni, emalangeni, nasemabitweni angempela. Landzela leto tindlela emephini, ngekulandzelana kwesikhatsi — tsintsa liphuzu, nome ucindzetele u-▶ kuze uhambe kuko sigaba ngesigaba.
s.ot_lead: Akusilo luhambo lolulodvwa kodvwa kugeleta kwemlandvo wensindziso kusukela ekudalweni: kudala nekuwa → sikhukhula neBabeli → kubita (Abrahama) → live lesetsembiso → kuPhuma → ihlane → kunqoba → umbuso → kwehlukana → kutfunjwa → kubuya.
s.je_lead: Landzela imphilo yaJesu njengobe emaVangeli ayilandza, ngekulandzelana — kusukela ekutalweni kwakhe eBetlehema, ngekubhabhatiswa kwakhe nenkonzo yakhe eGalile, adzabula eSamariya, kuya esiphambanweni, ekuvukeni, nasekwenyukeleni ezulwini eJerusalema.
s.pa_h: Kusukela e-Antiyokhi kuya emikhawulweni yemhlaba — eRoma
s.pa_lead: Kusukela ePhentekoste eJerusalema, kutsi livangeli lasakateka kanjani ngaphandle kweJudiya — ngekwedlula e-Asiya Lencane naseYurophu kuya enhlitiyweni yembuso. Khetsa lenye yaletinkhambo letisihlanu (1·2·3 + luhambo loluya eRoma + ngemuva kwekukhululwa) ulandzele tehlakalo teMisebenti yebaPhostoli kanye netincwadzi letabhalwa endleleni.
s.foot: Imitfombo · Tindzawo tilandzela umbhalo weBhayibheli nejografi lejwayelekile yeBhayibheli (ngemabito emanje lapho asita khona). Migcele yelwandle, imifula, netichibi kudvwetjwe kusukela kudatha yejografi levulekile (Natural Earth), yentiwa lula.

eden.name: Edeni (Kudala · Kuwa)
eden.note: Emhlabeni lobekumuhle kakhulu, sono siyangena sephule budlelwane emkhatsini waNkulunkulu nebantfu.

noah.name: Ararathi (Sikhukhula)
noah.note: Nkulunkulu wehlulela umhlaba logcwele sono, kepha wagcina imphilo ngemndeni munye.
events: Sivumelwane selutsingo — “ngeke kuphindze kubhujiswe lutfo ngemanti azamcolo”

babel.name: Umbhoshongo waseBabeli
babel.note: Ekutigcabheni lokufinyelela ezulwini, Nkulunkulu wasakata lulwimi lwabo nebantfu emhlabeni wonkhe.
events: Bantfu bahlakateka emhlabeni wonkhe (Shinari — ngemuva kwaloko iBhabhulona)

ur.name: Uri
ur.note: Indzaba yensindziso yeBhayibheli icala ngekubitwa kwendvodza yinye.
events: Nkulunkulu ubita Abramu aphume e-Uri lemaKhalediya
“Ngitakwenta ube sive lesikhulu … Tive tonkhe temhlaba tiyawubusiswa ngawe”

haran.name: Harani
events: Abramu usuka aya eKhanani aneminyaka lengema-75

shechem.name: Shekemu · Khanani
shechem.note: Eliveni lesetsembiso kwakhiwa umndeni futsi sivumelwane siyendluliselwa etitukulwaneni.
events: Kungena eKhanani, lilati lekucala — “Lelive ngiyawulinika titukulwane takho”
Emadvodzana laJakobe lalishumi nakubili — imphandze yetitfwala letilishumi nakubili

egypt.name: Gibhithe (Gosheni)
egypt.note: Umndeni uba sive lesikhulu — bese uba sive setigcili.
events: Umndeni wonkhe waJakobe wehlela phansi ubalekela indlala

sinai.name: iNtsaba iSinayi
sinai.note: Insindziso lesemkhatsini yeTestamente Lendzala — tigcili tiba sive saNkulunkulu ngekwaso.

kadesh.name: Khadeshi (ihlane)
kadesh.note: Kungakholwa kulahlekelwa situkulwane live — kepha Nkulunkulu uhlala nabo.
events: Tinhloli letilishumi nakubili — kodvwa sive siyala kwetsemba
Iminyaka lengema-38 ehlane — imana, lifu, nemlilo

shiloh.name: Shilo (Tikhulu)
shiloh.note: Ngaphandle kwenkhosi, ngulowo nalowo wenta lakutsandzako — kudzingeka inkhosi yangempela.
events: Ruthe — kwetsembeka emalangeni lamnyama, elusendvweni lwakaDavide

jerusalem.name: Jerusalema · Umbuso Lohlangene
jerusalem.note: Sikhatsi segolide sema-Israyeli — netsembiso senkhosi yaphakadze.
events: Sawula inkhosi yekucala, bese kuba David naGoliyathi
Sivumelwane naDavide — “Sihlalo sakho sebukhosi siyakuhlala sisimile phakadze” (2 Sam 7)

samaria.name: Samariya · Umbuso Lowehlukene
samaria.note: Umbuso uyahlukana wehla njengobe baphrofethi bakhala.
events: Ngemuva kwaSolomoni, kwehlukana kwaba Juda na-Israyeli
Elija, Isaya, Jeremiya bakhala batsi “buyani” — futsi baphrofetha ngeMesiya

nineveh.name: Ninive (Asiriya)
nineveh.note: Ngekungananaki tonkhe tecwayiso, inyakatfo iwa kucala.

babylon.name: iBhabhulona
babylon.note: Busuku lobumnyama kakhulu — kepha setsembiso sekubuyiselwa sisele.

susa.name: Susa (Pheresiya)
susa.note: Ngisho enhlitiyweni yembuso webahedeni, Nkulunkulu ugcina sive sakhe.

return.name: Kubuyela eJerusalema
return.note: Bayabuya bakhe kabusha — kodvwa akukho nkhosi lefikile. Balindze iMesiya.
events: Emagagasi lamatsatfu ekubuya ngesimemetelo saKhoresi (Zerubhabheli 538 · Ezra 458 · Nehemiya 444)
Lithempeli lakhiwa kabusha netibondza taseJerusalema tabuyiselwa
Malakhi — iTestamente Lendzala iyaphetsa: “ngiyawutfumela sitfunywa sami”

bethlehem.name: Betlehema
bethlehem.note: IMesiya leyetsenjisiwe ifika edolobheni laDavide — liVi laba yinyama.

nazareth.name: Nazaretha
events: Aneminyaka lelishumi nakubili, abuta futsi aphendvula ethempelini

jordan.name: uMfula iJordani
jordan.note: Inkonzo yakhe yembikwebantfu iyacala — izulu limbeka njengeNdvodzana.
events: Moya wehlela njengelijuba — “Lena yiNdvodzana yami, letsandzekako”

cana.name: Khana
cana.note: Esibonakalisweni sakhe sekucala wembula inkhatimulo yakhe.
events: Emanti aphendvuka aba liwayini — sibonakaliso sakhe sekucala

sychar.name: Sikhari (Samariya)
sychar.note: Umgwaco wenkonzo yekucala — ngeJerusalema kuya eSamariya leyayideleliwe.

capernaum.name: Khaphenawume
capernaum.note: Sisekelo senkonzo yaseGalile — kubita, kufundzisa, nekuphikiswa konkhe kuhlangana lapha.

galilee.name: Lwandle lwaseGalile
galilee.note: Ngemandla etulu kwemvelo ukhombisa kutsi ungubani.
events: Usutsisa bantfu labati-5 000 ngetinkhwa letisihlanu netinhlanti letimbili

caesarea_p.name: Khesariya Filiphi
caesarea_p.note: Bafundzi bayabona kutsi unguKhristu, indlela yesiphambano ivuleka.

bethany.name: Bethaniya
bethany.note: Ukhombisa emandla etulu kwekufa ngobusuku ngembi kweliviki lakhe lekugcina.

jerusalem.name: Jerusalema
jerusalem.note: Sicongo yonkhe iBhayibheli lesikhomba kuso — siphambano, kuvuka, kwenyukela ezulwini.
events: Kungena kwekunqoba; ubuye agenculule ematafula ethempelini
Uvuka ngelilanga lesitsatfu, bese wenyukela ezulwini

antioch.name: Antiyokhi
antioch.note: Libandla lelitfumelako lapho inkonzo yebetive icala ibuyele khona.
events: Libandla lapho bakholwa baqala kubitwa khona ngekutsi “emaKhristu”
Liphuzu lekusuka lwekuhamba kwekucala, kwesibili, nekwesitsatfu

seleucia.name: Selusiya
seleucia.note: Litheku la-Antiyokhi — bagibela umkhumbi baya eSiphrosi.

perga.name: Phega
perga.note: Litheku lasePhamfiliya — lapha Johane Makho ubuyela emuva.

iconium.name: Ikhoniyu
iconium.note: Labanyenti bayakholwa, kodvwa kushushiswa kubaphocelela kutsi bachubeke.

lystra.name: Lisitra
events: Wakhandvwa ngematje washiywa afile, kodvwa uyavuka

derbe.name: Dhebe
derbe.note: Kwentiwa bafundzi labanyenti; babuyela ngendlela leyodvwa baciniso emabandla.

troas.name: Throwasi
troas.note: Liphuzu lekuguculuka lapho livangeli licala khona kubheka eYurophu.

philippi.name: Filiphi
philippi.note: Libandla lekucala laseYurophu — livangeli linqoba ngisho ejele.
events: Tingoma phakatsi kwebusuku, kutamatama komhlaba, umndeni wemgcinijele uyasindziswa

berea.name: Bheriya
events: Onkhe emalanga bahlola imiBhalo kucinisekisa loko

corinth.name: Korinthe
corinth.note: Uhlala umnyaka nesigamu, atjala libandla edolobheni lebubi.

ephesus.name: Efesu
ephesus.note: Inhlitiyo yekuhamba kwesitsatfu — liVi lisakateka kulo lonkhe live lase-Asiya.
events: Kufundzisa nsuku tonkhe iminyaka lemibili endlini yekufundzela yaThiranu

miletus.name: Miletu
events: “neluse libandla laNkulunkulu latitsengela lona ngengati yeNdvodzana yakhe”
Labadzala bayakhala, bati kutsi ngeke baphindze bambone

caesarea.name: Khesariya
caesarea.note: Iminyaka lemibili uvikela livangeli embikwebabusi nenkhosi.

jerusalem.name: Jerusalema
jerusalem.note: Ubanjwa ethempelini, indlela yakhe njengesibotjwa iyacala.
events: Njengesakhamuti saseRoma, utfunyelwa ngaphansi kwebalindzi eKhesariya

fairhaven.name: Emachwebeni Lamahle (Kreta)
fairhaven.note: Secwayiso saPawula sekutsi bayekele kuhamba asinakwa.

crete.name: Kreta
crete.note: Ngemuva kwekukhululwa kwakhe, sichingi lapho ashiya khona Thithusi kutsi ahlele emabandla.
events: Ushiya Thithusi kutsi abeke labadzala kuwo onkhe emadolobha

malta.name: Melitha
malta.note: Ngesivunguvungu nekubhidlika komkhumbi, setsembiso saNkulunkulu siyema.
events: “Umoya wasenyakatfo-mphumalanga” ubhidlita umkhumbi, kodvwa bonkhe laba-276 bayasindza

rome.name: Roma
rome.note: Livangeli lifika enhlitiyweni yembuso ekugcineni — akusiko kuphela kodvwa kucala.
events: Iminyaka lemibili aboshelwe endlini, amemetela umbuso ngesibindzi
Ngemuva kwaloko uphindze aboshwe, ubhala 2 kuThimothi bese uyabulawelwa kukholwa — “Ngikulwile kulwa lokuhle, sengiyicedzile indzima yami”
